tau._comment: Coverage threshold per task type. Pre-registered; not adaptive.

distinctness._comment: B2≠B1 gate: B2 must have strictly fewer retrieved_records than B1 for at least one task in the eval set. Without this, a null result ('minimality does not help') is indistinguishable from 'minimality was not activated'.

c17_verifier_collision._comment: Resolution for C17 verifier name collision. Option (a) renaming is rejected (changes pinned task-config hashes). Option (b) indexed verifier bridge is selected.
c17_verifier_collision.note: run_verifiers_indexed keys results by position (e.g. '0:create_new_case') so colliding names no longer overwrite each other. The benchmark code is unmodified.

multi_anchor._comment: Multi-anchor (blueprint section 3/4) is deferred. All 11 eval tasks resolve to exactly one anchor row; implementing multi-anchor yields zero payoff on this benchmark and requires changes to 6+ files.
